verdict.rationale: GitCafe's docs say you can track work with issues, labels and milestones, and issues are a first-class object across the CLI, MCP server, webhooks and GitHub sync. This covers issue tracking with labels. Assignees are never mentioned, and there are no hands-on accounts of the issue workflow. Missing for 10: documented issue assignees, a dedicated issues guide covering bug/feature/requirement workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
